## Set up your sound, right on your Mac
Onda now guides you through four short steps: main speakers, a left/right sound check, optional room speakers, and your sound. An iPhone is optional.
- Choose one stereo device or a left and right pair. Your existing speaker choices are kept. - Play each side when ready, swap if needed, and adjust the shared volume. - Add connected Bluetooth, Wi-Fi or USB room outputs, or skip this step. Room speakers join Spotify music; connection help opens macOS settings only when you choose it. - Choose Balanced, Warm or Clear, then adjust bass, treble and speaker levels. Undo sound changes restores the music preferences from before your first adjustment. - Finish later and continue from the saved step. Applied choices stay saved. Setup is available again from Speakers.
The guide pauses changes during calls, video, tuning and audio connection work. A disconnected main speaker or an unapplied output selection prevents finishing with an invalid setup. Selecting AirPlay in macOS keeps speaker discovery available so you can add it.
## What stays the same
Opening the guide does not apply a preset, switch outputs or reset measurements. Tone controls are personal preferences, not measured room correction. Existing measured room EQ and timing are retained; changed tone can bypass measured EQ. New acoustic measurements still require the iPhone companion and the supported Studio Display topology. Other groups use estimated/manual timing, with fine adjustments in Speakers → Manage speakers.
Room speakers currently share Spotify audio. Calls and video use the main outputs. Up to four added speakers and one system AirPlay route are supported; a Sonos group counts as one output.
## Install and update
Universal Apple silicon and Intel download for macOS 14 or later; Spotify sharing needs macOS 14.2. Signed with Developer ID, notarized by Apple and stapled. The bundled audio driver is unchanged. New installations need administrator approval for the audio driver; existing users do not need a driver update for this guide.
Updater-enabled betas receive this through the signed feed. Updates download quietly and install on normal quit; recognized calls, video and tuning postpone checks. A deferred manual restart still requires a fresh click when idle. Beta 112 or earlier needs one manual installation to enable automatic updates. The iPhone app is separate and is not included in this Mac download.
## Verification
The existing source regression run passed 268 Swift tests, with zero failures and five environment-dependent skips. The final 45 focused tests passed, including four new guided-setup regressions, primary output safety, room speaker commands, native call detection and updater protections. Shared native setup views were rendered and reviewed in light and dark appearance with synthetic fixtures, without starting an audio engine or changing the development Mac's output. Universal signatures, notarization/staples, mounted contents and the actual public archive are checked before updating the signed feed. Fresh-machine installation and audible generic-speaker playback remain unverified.
